condition_number_on_correlation.rule: the identifiability condition number is taken on the posterior CORRELATION matrix, D^-1/2 C D^-1/2, in assess_identifiability (V1), in the routed classification, and in the read-back re-derivation
condition_number_on_correlation.class: the threshold stays class C; the change makes it invariant to each parameter's unit and scale (class A property)
condition_number_on_correlation.why: the raw-covariance condition number mixes parameter units: rescaling one parameter by k multiplies its variance by k^2, so the same posterior crossed 1e6 in micrometres and not in metres
condition_number_on_correlation.not_changed: the correlation threshold and the relative-width threshold

width_reference_is_stated.rule: every identifiability explanation states that relative widths are measured against each parameter's declared zero, and that a parameterization with another origin can reach another verdict
width_reference_is_stated.why: an origin-invariant width criterion needs a declared scale of interest, which no parameter declaration carries; inventing one would be a new, unrecorded assumption. The dependence is made explicit instead of removed
width_reference_is_stated.status_it_leads_to: PARTIAL: the unit dependence is removed, the origin dependence is stated

grid_prior_is_uniform_in_inference_coord.rule: a grid route (supplied or rebuilt) and grid_predictive_uncertainty given the evidence accept a grid only if every axis is uniformly spaced in the parameter's inference coordinate: natural for IDENTITY, logarithm for LOG. Transforms come from the calibration when one is given; without a calibration every axis must be uniform in its natural coordinate
grid_prior_is_uniform_in_inference_coord.why: gaussian_grid_posterior gives every node equal prior mass, so node density IS the prior density. On an axis uniform in the inference coordinate that is the declared prior; on any other it is an undeclared informative prior
grid_prior_is_uniform_in_inference_coord.uniformity_tolerance: max |step - mean step| <= 1e-6 * mean step on every axis
grid_prior_is_uniform_in_inference_coord.tolerance_class: A (a float64 linspace and its image through exp/log reproduce equal steps far inside this)
grid_prior_is_uniform_in_inference_coord.reason: GRID_PRIOR_NOT_UNIFORM_IN_INFERENCE_COORDINATES (router: passed over; grid_predictive_uncertainty with evidence: HybridUQError)
grid_prior_is_uniform_in_inference_coord.not_changed: gaussian_grid_posterior and PosteriorGrid (V1): a grid is still an exact discrete posterior under equal node mass; only routed claims are held to this
